title: Compile programmable native stages and coded-thin fusion with exact precision (no new kappa)
body:
This extends #5466/#5467 with an actual rational-amplitude native event compiler, coded-thin fusion at existing common-frame cuts, and source-bound exact dyadic precision for both orientations. It retains #5464's actual paid/monomial/phase paths and checks all 1,024 independent columns. The fusion adds no Gaussian child, field or phase path. Exact dyadic storage B = g + ceil(25f/2) + 4 suffices for the actual streams; a constructive composition theorem covers an emitted dyadic caller.

**No new complete κ is established.** The old closing swap still gives one wrong-side-Q output branch. C-coded thin service is not uncoded same-port service. Ideal funding models are excluded from this result, and no arithmetic-only endpoint is promoted as a multiplier bound.

Reproduce with Python 3.12 and the standard library:
```sh
python -I -B research/programmable-native-stage/verify.py
python -I -O -B research/programmable-native-stage/verify.py
```

Normal and optimized checks, literal chart/column/paid-profile tests, exact noncommuting controls and precision mutation rejection pass. No Lean kernel audit or hosted Linux CI is claimed. No selected record, predecessor evidence or shared tooling changes.

Credit THU New Media Research Center #5464, Ali Romman #5439, Dugongue #4929/#5466/#5467, Dillon Amburgey, Cao Yifan, Cinna Davis, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman, Chris R/Clear1nsight and the retained native/Clifford/compiler/analytic lineage. Exact source pins and original notices remain. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance by one coordinator and three agents; Apache-2.0. Open next questions give the precise sufficient global closure still needed.
